name: 2K23 Corner$
description: Released February 7, 2023 as a single, "2K23 Corner$" pairs Fleekz with That Boy Hi Hat for a dangerous, aggressive underground hip hop cut straight from the street-narrative playbook. Fleekz sets the tone with hungry, hard-hitting delivery over trap drums and a bass-heavy mix; then That Boy Hi Hat slides in and reminds you why his "Appears On" section is worth checking — a feature verse that treats the corner as both setting and state of mind. The production is lean and menacing: crisp hi-hats, an 808-driven low end, and an atmospheric edge that keeps the record nocturnal without losing its daytime punch. Explicit and unapologetic, "2K23 Corner$" is a time capsule of the 2023 underground and a key early link between That Boy Hi Hat and the wider CWI orbit — the kind of collaboration that foreshadows a catalog. For That Boy Hi Hat completists, it is an essential feature; for Fleekz, it is the calling card.
